clips.send: Someone who's been vague about their goals sends this to a friend who never says what they actually want out loud: a 2,000-year-old story where naming it plainly, with real feeling, is what made it happen.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau points to a passage in the Book of Mark as a live demonstration of the law of attraction.

Jesus and his disciples come across a fig tree with leaves but no fruit. Jesus gets angry, says out loud that no one will ever eat from it again, and walks on.

Days later, on the same road home, the disciples find the tree completely withered from the roots - dead.

Kevin's take: the anger wasn't the problem. It was the fuel. He knew exactly what he wanted, and he said it out loud.

What have you been quietly hoping for instead of saying it plainly?
